Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE independent hand-painted game run animation sprite of the same Ghost Script Calligrapher Boy. Input 1 is the approved FRONT/S-facing identity, anatomy, costume and camera reference. Input 2 is original identity portrait. Input 3 is PRIMARY approved clean polished Taoist chibi painting style; borrow rendering only, no UI or lettering. This is new animation anatomy, not recolored idle.
Character faces straight SOUTH toward viewer, full frontal head, both amber eyes, not a three-quarter side turn. Native square at least 1024x1024, transparent alpha background. Fixed orthographic camera: head width 34% of canvas, body center x50%, same scale as input1, nominal ground line y92%. All props/feet/ribbon inside generous margin. Torso leans slightly toward viewer for forward travel.
Preserve short brown straight tousled hair/high bun, yin-yang ornament, plain teal ribbon tails, jade forehead diamond, amber eyes; charcoal gold-cloud short robe with ivory lining, jade belt yin-yang buckle, FULL LENGTH dark trousers reaching black/gold boots. No bare calf, no skin below waist, no white socks. Anatomical RIGHT hand is on image LEFT and grips brush; anatomical LEFT hand is on image RIGHT and grips blank ivory hanging scroll. Do not swap hands. Exactly two pale cyan ink spirits travel beside scroll. One small legitimate teal brush tassel only at top handle butt, never near bristles. Scroll one yin-yang teal tassel, no ornament at hair ribbon tips. Clear five-finger grip and connected wrists, exactly two arms/two hands/two legs/two boots. Smooth clean alpha edges, no white/pink/cyan fringe, no floating specks. No floor shadow, particles, magic trails, texts or extra objects.
POSE: run/S/13 LEFT TOE-OFF leading to right step. The anatomical LEFT leg (image RIGHT) is extended BACK behind pelvis, left heel high and just left toe presses the virtual ground. The RIGHT leg (image LEFT) swings FORWARD with knee flexed only about 35 degrees and low, boot moving toward viewer but still raised above contact line. No thigh lifted to chest. Body has risen slightly from support phase. The left toe is the last contact, not a forward flat planted boot. Opposite coordinated arms: RIGHT brush hand swings BACK beside right hip on image left with elbow angled back; LEFT scroll hand swings FORWARD to low chest on image right with elbow flexed. Brush bristles point down/back clear of trousers; scroll advances beside body. Clearly show opposite leg and shoulder phase from right-toe-off. Running forward rather than standing or marching.
